Name: No Wiki Hardcore Mode
Author: nightshademagia
Description:
If the mod finds that you have the Stardew Valley Wiki open in a browser or the like, it will delete your save file and immediately send you back to the title screen without asking permission.

This idea came from [url=https://x.com/HardDriveMag/status/1804141998754140305]this tweet by @HardDriveMag.
[/url]

Manifest.Name: Hardcore Mode
Manifest.Description: Deletes your save file if it detects you have the wiki open in a browser window.
Manifest.Author: Nightshade System
